steps.en: Drink plenty of fluids, preferably water.
steps.hi: ख़ूब पानी और तरल चीज़ें पीजिए।
steps.hinglish: Khoob paani aur liquid cheezein peejiye.

steps.en: Stay at home until it settles.
steps.hi: ठीक होने तक घर पर रहिए।
steps.hinglish: Theek hone tak ghar par rahiye.

seeDoctorIf.en: It is not getting better, or is getting worse.
seeDoctorIf.hi: बुखार ठीक न हो या बढ़ता जाए।
seeDoctorIf.hinglish: Bukhar theek na ho ya badhta jaye.

seeDoctorIf.en: It is very high or will not come down.
seeDoctorIf.hi: बहुत तेज़ हो या उतर न रहा हो।
seeDoctorIf.hinglish: Bahut tez ho ya utar na raha ho.
